statusDefinitions.base: Mature starting-world technology or a later derivative/revival of that baseline family. Base does not mean obsolete or primitive.
statusDefinitions.existing: Already expected or established by the current Star Cluster Concept/accepted architecture. Story placement may still be refined before numerical table work.
statusDefinitions.candidate: A strong proposed addition with a coherent scientific/engineering premise and gameplay role. Candidate is not yet an adopted component or numerical TL-table entry.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Worth preserving, but the owning family, era, prerequisites, gameplay role, or implementation cost is not settled enough for promotion.
statusDefinitions.exotic: Precursor-grade, rule-bending, deliberately extreme weird science, or technology otherwise outside the normal player-developed TL1-TL9 ladder.

structuralRoleDefinitions.core_family: Primary lineage normally represented by a standard/base component family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.maturation: Improves integration, efficiency, reliability, packaging, resilience, or a bounded operating property without changing the core principle.
structuralRoleDefinitions.branch: A specialist or alternate lineage that coexists with the main family rather than automatically replacing it.
structuralRoleDefinitions.cross_pollinated_derivative: An owning-tree technology unlocked or transformed by a genuinely enabling external research discipline.
structuralRoleDefinitions.legacy_revival: A mature older family becomes strategically interesting again because later science enables a new niche or performance envelope.
structuralRoleDefinitions.operating_capability: A mode or capability applied to an existing family rather than a new hardware family.
structuralRoleDefinitions.specialist_auxiliary: A support installation that creates a meaningful design choice without becoming a new visible research tree.
structuralRoleDefinitions.one_off: A useful technology that may have no natural multi-TL progression and does not need a successor merely to fill a cell.
structuralRoleDefinitions.infrastructure: A strategic/site technology rather than an ordinary player-cruiser component.
structuralRoleDefinitions.campaign_technology: A technology whose principal value is exploration, logistics, salvage, diplomacy, or campaign consequence rather than direct combat.
structuralRoleDefinitions.weird_science: A speculative but potentially normal-player scientific concept that can exist as a one-off or rare branch without becoming Precursor magic.
structuralRoleDefinitions.precursor_artifact: Non-player-developed Precursor technology or artifact behavior; TL10 is shorthand only.

ideas.title: Advanced Fission Specialist Reactor
ideas.summary: Later materials/direct-conversion engineering revives fission as a rugged, low-maintenance or damage-tolerant specialist rather than raw-output champion.

ideas.title: Supercapacitor Pulse Bank
ideas.summary: High-discharge storage supports burst weapons, shields or emergency power without increasing sustained reactor output.

ideas.title: Superconducting Magnetic Energy Store
ideas.summary: Low-loss magnetic storage/conditioning enabled by advanced superconductors.

ideas.title: Thermal Suppression Module
ideas.summary: Retractable radiators/heat storage create a finite quiet/high-output window; no global heat meter.

ideas.title: Nuclear-Electric Expedition Drive
ideas.summary: Efficient low-thrust specialist propulsion for probes/logistics; not the tactical cruiser default.

ideas.title: Nuclear-Thermal Sprint Drive
ideas.summary: Higher-thrust fission propulsion niche with different propellant/integration tradeoffs.

ideas.title: Fission-Pulse Drive
ideas.summary: A rugged pulsed propulsion branch enabled by advanced structures/materials.

ideas.title: Antimatter-Catalyzed Fusion Drive
ideas.summary: Small antimatter quantities catalyze mature fusion propulsion before full antimatter drives dominate.

ideas.title: Generated Gravity Module
ideas.summary: A higher-SF architectural breakthrough replacing some spin/acceleration-gravity burden; initially little direct tactical effect.

ideas.title: Inertial Compensation Field
ideas.summary: Reduces crew/structure acceleration burden; gameplay relation to STL/evasion remains undefined.

ideas.title: Molecular Repair Fabricator
ideas.summary: Onboard manufacturing improves field repair using resources; no free component resurrection.

ideas.title: Bounded Self-Healing Hull Material
ideas.summary: Self-healing materials restore limited Integrity/repairability rather than full regeneration.

ideas.title: Biomechanical Repair Organ
ideas.summary: Localized biological component with bounded healing/support needs; does not imply whole living ship.

ideas.title: Sentient Ship Core
ideas.summary: Potential digital/biological sentience with narrative/diplomatic consequences; not just +computer bonus.

ideas.title: Photonic Combat Computer
ideas.summary: Optical computing provides a qualitative architecture shift in throughput/efficiency.

ideas.title: Quantum Tactical Optimizer
ideas.summary: Quantum-assisted optimization accelerates selected battle-state calculations without omniscience.

ideas.title: Autonomous Damage-Control Drones
ideas.summary: Robotics improve dangerous repair/isolation tasks using existing condition/Repair Kit rules.

ideas.title: Cooperative Sensor Network
ideas.summary: Allied assets share observations/track provenance instead of simply adding sensor range.

ideas.title: Low-Probability Active Sensor Mode
ideas.summary: Advanced waveform/control trades power/discrimination against emission conspicuousness.

ideas.title: Quantum/Field Sensor Suite
ideas.summary: Specialist weak-signal or field sensing helps against advanced signatures without guaranteeing detection.

ideas.title: Spacetime/FTL-Wake Detector
ideas.summary: Detects metric disturbances/transit wakes as a new information channel.

ideas.title: False-Track / Decoy Synthesis ECM
ideas.summary: Qualitative deception attacks provenance/identification rather than only increasing ECM rating.

ideas.title: Anti-Emitter Targeting Suite
ideas.summary: Turns hostile active emissions into localization/weapon opportunities.

ideas.title: Thermal Signature Suppression
ideas.summary: Finite quiet-state window from thermal architecture; not total stealth.

ideas.title: Active Signature Cancellation
ideas.summary: Channel-specific powered signature reshaping; role/counters need design.

ideas.title: Powered Concealment Field
ideas.summary: Rare cloak-like powered system with incompatibilities, costs and no default perfect invisibility.

ideas.title: Phase Cloak
ideas.summary: Precursor device that explicitly breaks ordinary observability/interaction rules under narrow constraints.

ideas.title: Nanostructured Armor Matrix
ideas.summary: Advanced carbon/superalloy materials improve specific protection and thermal resilience.

ideas.title: Self-Healing Smart Armor
ideas.summary: Restores limited armor Integrity/repairability between severe events.

ideas.title: Particle/Radiation Hardening Package
ideas.summary: Specialized countermeasure for ionizing/particle effects rather than universal defense.

ideas.title: Field-Assisted Armor
ideas.summary: Material/field layer redistributes stress/energy but remains penetrable and power-limited.

ideas.title: Segmented Shield Control
ideas.summary: Concentrates or isolates field coverage at real power/geometry tradeoffs.

ideas.title: Adaptive Shield Hardener
ideas.summary: Tunes field protection against a narrow threat class rather than universal SA growth.

ideas.title: Metric Barrier Shield
ideas.summary: Spacetime/field manipulation deflects attacks while preserving finite capacity/counterplay.

ideas.title: Stasis Barrier
ideas.summary: Precursor field that can temporarily suspend or exclude interaction; event-grade technology.

ideas.title: Tunable-Spectrum Laser
ideas.summary: Adaptive wavelength weapon trades flexibility against optimized specialization.

ideas.title: Distributed Phased Beam Director
ideas.summary: Multiple apertures share a bounded output pool for rapid retargeting/resilience.

ideas.title: Ion Cannon / Charged-Particle Cannon
ideas.summary: Particle accelerator weapon with distinct material/electronics/radiation interaction and specialist counters.

ideas.title: Neutral Particle Beam
ideas.summary: Beam conditioning/neutralization improves range/focus over charged-beam precursors.

ideas.title: Plasma Cannon
ideas.summary: Higher-SF contained plasma projectile/beam concept with short-range/high-interaction niche.

ideas.title: Nuclear-Pumped One-Shot Laser
ideas.summary: Rare sacrificial/coupled weapon requiring preparation and severe consequences.

ideas.title: Microwave Electronic-Attack Emitter
ideas.summary: Beam-family crossover that disrupts electronics/sensors more than structure.

ideas.title: Radiation Disruption Weapon
ideas.summary: Specialist crew/electronics effect; wait until internal consequence model warrants it.

ideas.title: Matter-Bond Disruptor
ideas.summary: Science-fantasy weapon destabilizing material structure; mechanics/counters unresolved.

ideas.title: Singularity / Black-Hole Gun
ideas.summary: Artificial-singularity weapon/power concept preserved as Precursor/weird-science event, not normal player progression.

ideas.title: Superconducting Coil Cannon
ideas.summary: Advanced magnets/materials enable a new accelerator envelope.

ideas.title: Helical / Continuous Induction Cannon
ideas.summary: Alternate accelerator trades velocity, rate, wear and architecture.

ideas.title: Smart Guided Kinetic Round
ideas.summary: Terminal correction/fuzing improves projectile flexibility without becoming a missile flight.

ideas.title: Macron Accelerator
ideas.summary: Very small hypervelocity projectiles create a distinct saturation/deposition niche and demanding launcher.

ideas.title: Relativistic Kinetic Lance
ideas.summary: Extreme projectile velocity with strict accuracy/collateral/launcher limits.

ideas.title: Exotic Dense-Matter Projectile
ideas.summary: Engineered high-density projectile; material provenance and gameplay counterplay unresolved.

ideas.title: Advanced Beam Point-Defense Maturation
ideas.summary: Advanced rapid steering, multi-threat coordination, or adaptive-spectrum behavior for the separate Energy/Beam PDS lineage. Beam PDS itself is already a TL1 baseline and does not originate here.

ideas.title: Guided Interceptor PDS
ideas.summary: Smart local intercept rounds improve PDS efficiency while preserving finite RC/Ammo.

ideas.title: Long-Range AMM Layer
ideas.summary: Guided anti-missile layer extends defense outside terminal PDS.

ideas.title: Anti-Emitter Missile
ideas.summary: Specialist seeker homes on active radar/ECM/communications emissions.

ideas.title: Cooperative Missile Swarm
ideas.summary: Flight-level coordination/decoys/submunitions improve saturation and target assignment without literal counter explosion.

ideas.title: Multi-Mode Terminal Seeker
ideas.summary: Seeker robustness and countermeasure rejection improve independently of warhead.

ideas.title: Shaped Nuclear Warhead
ideas.summary: Nuclear payload geometry creates directed high-energy attack with conspicuous costs.

ideas.title: Antimatter-Catalyzed Warhead
ideas.summary: Tiny antimatter quantities catalyze high-energy payloads before pure antimatter munitions.

ideas.title: Antimatter Warhead
ideas.summary: Extreme energy payload whose scarcity/containment is part of its identity.

ideas.title: Matter-Conversion Warhead
ideas.summary: Pinnacle payload using direct conversion; potentially destabilizing without strong scarcity/counters.

ideas.title: Probe/Survey Drone Package
ideas.summary: Disposable/reusable probes automate routine surveying while preserving player risk decisions.

ideas.title: Autonomous Long-Endurance Probe
ideas.summary: AI/efficient propulsion supports long autonomous exploration without eliminating strandedness or discovery uncertainty.

ideas.title: Minefield Deployment System
ideas.summary: Chokepoint/system hazard rather than tactical mine spam; requires sweeping/observer-safe hazard states.

ideas.title: Mine-Sweeping Sensor/Drone Suite
ideas.summary: Specialized counterplay if minefields are adopted.

ideas.title: Tractor/Tow Field
ideas.summary: Localized force-manipulation system for towing, salvage or boarding support; avoid turning it into universal movement control.

ideas.title: Reactionless Maneuvering Drive
ideas.summary: Field propulsion with no conventional reaction mass; requires strong costs/limits to preserve logistics.

ideas.title: Micro-Jump Tactical Drive
ideas.summary: Short tactical transitions could bypass geometry/interception and are therefore deferred pending a dedicated combat-architecture study.

ideas.title: Player-Built Fixed Transit Gate
ideas.summary: Rare late infrastructure that changes sector topology rather than onboard movement.

ideas.title: Precursor Transit Gate
ideas.summary: Ancient fixed route that may violate one ordinary FTL rule.

ideas.title: Traversable Wormhole Generator
ideas.summary: Rule-bending spacetime topology device requiring exotic physics; not normal player research.

ideas.title: Warp/Metric Bubble Artifact
ideas.summary: Precursor device using extreme spacetime distortion beyond normal player FTL.

ideas.title: Vacuum-Energy Tap
ideas.summary: Unbounded-looking power source deliberately kept outside normal player progression unless future lore imposes severe constraints.

ideas.title: Artificial Black-Hole Reactor
ideas.summary: Artificial singularity as Hawking-radiation power source; extreme event technology.

ideas.title: Negative-Mass / Exotic-Matter Field Core
ideas.summary: Exotic-matter source for spacetime devices; provenance/containment itself is campaign content.

ideas.title: Dimensional Pocket Storage
ideas.summary: Interior volume or storage not matching external geometry; intentionally breaks Installation-Space assumptions.

ideas.title: Temporal Repair Device
ideas.summary: Restores a bounded prior state or reverses damage; a clear rule-breaking artifact, not ordinary Damage Control.

ideas.title: Causal/Precognitive Sensor
ideas.summary: Obtains information unavailable through normal causal observation; conflicts with player-information architecture and is reserved for explicit Precursor exceptions.

ideas.title: Phase-Shift Armor
ideas.summary: Temporarily removes matter from normal interaction; event-grade defensive exception.

ideas.title: Living Precursor Starship
ideas.summary: Sentient/biomechanical vessel whose support and repair rules differ from normal player hulls.

ideas.title: Exotic-Matter Sample / Key Material
ideas.summary: Recovered matter that acts as prerequisite/currency for Precursor adaptation rather than a researchable universal resource.

ideas.title: FTL Communications
ideas.summary: Potential strategic communication breakthrough; consequences for isolation, diplomacy and exploration are large enough to require separate campaign design.

ideas.title: Radiation-Hardened Electronics
ideas.summary: Materials/architecture improve resilience against radiation/particle effects; use component traits rather than universal resistance meter.

ideas.title: Reconfigurable Service Bus
ideas.summary: Smart power/data/coolant routing improves refit/repair integration and legacy-component adaptation.

ideas.title: Advanced Decoy Flight
ideas.summary: Missile-like decoys/emitters attack seeker discrimination and consume defensive attention without free damage.

ideas.title: Laser-Pumped Particle Beam
ideas.summary: Laser/particle hybrid is retained as a late weird-science concept rather than normal automatic progression.

ideas.title: Directed-Energy Sail / Beamed-Propulsion Missile
ideas.summary: External beam drives a vehicle; only useful if it creates a distinct tactical/logistics niche over firing the beam directly.

ideas.title: Emergency Heat Sink Cartridge
ideas.summary: Finite-use thermal reserve for overload/stealth windows; no ongoing coolant inventory.

ideas.title: Adaptive Spectrum Shielding
ideas.summary: Field tuning responds to observed attack characteristics with power/coverage tradeoffs.

ideas.title: Programmable Matter Hull Patch
ideas.summary: Stored programmable matter forms temporary structural or interface repairs with finite resource use.

ideas.title: Exotic Matter Conversion Feedstock
ideas.summary: Rare feedstock could gate the strongest conversion systems if unlimited ordinary matter proves too permissive; not adopted.

ideas.title: Relativistic Dust Defensive Cloud
ideas.summary: Cloud/particle defense or denial concept; collateral and bookkeeping risks are high.

ideas.title: Anti-Particle Magnetic Screen
ideas.summary: Specialized defense against charged particle beams, weak versus unrelated threats.

ideas.title: High-Energy Neutrino/Exotic Sensor
ideas.summary: Penetrating sensing channel potentially useful against obscured targets; practical effectiveness/cost uncertain.

ideas.title: Adaptive Ammo Fabricator
ideas.summary: Onboard manufacturing can produce selected projectile packages from resources, trading flexibility against fabrication time/Space.

ideas.title: Missile Warhead Fabricator
ideas.summary: Manufacturing flexibility may let a ship replenish selected conventional warheads/ammo from resources outside combat.

ideas.title: Dynamic Field Mine
ideas.summary: Persistent field hazard with unusual trigger/geometry behavior; keep campaign-scale and sweepable if adopted.

ideas.title: Precursor Rule-Key Component Pair
ideas.summary: Matched artifact/coupler/stabilizer pair whose combination unlocks an otherwise incompatible rule-bending device.

ideas.title: Matter-Replication Fabricator
ideas.summary: Unconstrained replication would erase logistics and is therefore Precursor-only unless future rules impose strict feedstock/energy limits.

ideas.title: Localized Gravity Weapon
ideas.summary: Field weapon that perturbs trajectories/structure instead of ordinary beam damage; role and counters unresolved.

ideas.title: Peak Fission Main Reactor
ideas.summary: Highly mature fission is the normal baseline power technology: dependable, well-understood, and strategically useful even after successor families appear.

ideas.title: Early Practical Fusion Main Reactor
ideas.summary: The first practical Fusion family should be a genuinely different reactor principle whose design promise is more than simply Reactor 1 with a larger number.

ideas.title: Mature Compact Fusion Main Reactor
ideas.summary: Mature Fusion improves packaging/integration; the accepted TL3 6-TP / 5-Space base is retained as the numerical seed.

ideas.title: High-Output Fusion Main Reactor
ideas.summary: A strong mature Fusion form that pushes the output frontier after TL3 integration/miniaturization.

ideas.title: Early Antimatter Main Reactor
ideas.summary: Antimatter becomes a new higher-SF power family while peak Fusion remains a legitimate mature alternative.

ideas.title: Mature Antimatter Main Reactor
ideas.summary: Antimatter containment, conversion and integration mature into more practical ship-scale power architecture.

ideas.title: High-Output Antimatter Main Reactor
ideas.summary: Mature Antimatter pushes the high-output frontier while retaining containment/logistics identity.

ideas.title: Fractional / Direct Matter-Conversion Reactor
ideas.summary: The normal player ladder reaches early controlled matter conversion while peak Antimatter remains available as the mature predecessor.

ideas.title: Total Matter-Conversion Reactor
ideas.summary: Pinnacle normal-player power technology: extremely efficient conversion bounded by ship architecture and still distinct from Precursor rule-breaking.

ideas.title: Baseline Sublight Tactical Drive
ideas.summary: A mature slightly-futuristic tactical maneuvering family; later progression should tell a propulsion story rather than only increasing Move.

ideas.title: Practical Faster-Than-Light Drive
ideas.summary: A deliberate setting-defining miracle present at the baseline. It remains a distinct installed family from STL even though both share visible Propulsion research.

ideas.title: Baseline Defensive Shield Generator
ideas.summary: A deliberate setting-defining field technology available from the start; later progression can split capacity, recharge, geometry and hardening.

ideas.title: Baseline Kinetic Main Weapon
ideas.summary: Mature projectile/accelerator weapon family whose later identity should emphasize velocity, penetration, ammunition, launcher architecture and smart rounds rather than universal damage scaling.

ideas.title: Baseline Coherent-Energy Main Weapon
ideas.summary: Mature shipboard beam weapon family whose progression can involve emitter physics, wavelength, focusing, efficiency and operating modes.

ideas.title: Baseline Missile Weapon System
ideas.summary: Launcher, command guidance and payload form the baseline missile family; delivery, seeker/guidance and warhead may mature independently.

ideas.title: Baseline Kinetic Point Defense
ideas.summary: Local finite-capacity interception is a distinct defensive application of projectile technology rather than a generic ship defense statistic.

ideas.title: Baseline Multimodal Sensor Suite
ideas.summary: Mature passive/active sensing establishes the information-state game; later levels add modes, discrimination, cooperation and specialized channels.

ideas.title: Baseline ECM / ECCM Architecture
ideas.summary: Electronic attack and countermeasures begin as bounded rating-based systems; later families should add deception, anti-emitter behavior and efficiency rather than only rating inflation.

ideas.title: Baseline Tactical Computer / Fire Control
ideas.summary: Mature digital fire control coordinates targeting and ship combat without granting omniscience; later computing should change integration, efficiency and specialized assistance.

ideas.title: Baseline Cruiser Hull and Primary Armor
ideas.summary: The starting cruiser is already a sophisticated slightly-futuristic spacecraft using mature structural materials, compartmentation, diagnostics and layered passive protection.

ideas.title: Baseline Energy / Beam Point Defense
ideas.summary: Starting-available separate beam-PDS lineage: local interception, RC1, 2-TP readiness, and no conventional ammunition.

ideas.title: Baseline Local AMM Point Defense
ideas.summary: Starting-available local terminal interceptor lineage with RC1, 1-TP readiness, and finite ammunition; distinct from a later long-range AMM layer.

ideas.title: TL1 Ablative Outer Armor Layer
ideas.summary: Optional starting-legal outer armor installed as an Auxiliary/support component using universal Installation Space; not a separate AUX capacity and normally replaced rather than repaired in combat.

ideas.title: Medical Bay
ideas.summary: Space-consuming medical support that mitigates explicit casualty/recovery events without creating individual-health micromanagement.

ideas.title: Fuel Processor
ideas.summary: Field processor that enables or improves Fuel recovery at eligible sites, trading Space and time against expedition endurance.

ideas.title: Expedition Fuel / Endurance Module
ideas.summary: Optional reserve capacity or endurance support using the single broad Fuel abstraction rather than a tank-by-tank propellant system.

ideas.title: Advanced Shuttle / Mission Bay
ideas.summary: Hangar and mission-support branch that may add a second shuttle, heavier craft, faster turnaround, or safer operations after the starting-shuttle decision is confirmed.

ideas.title: Scientific Laboratory Module
ideas.summary: Installed analysis facility that improves Research Data interpretation, anomalies, ruins, artifacts, or alien technology without creating a separate Lab research discipline.

ideas.title: Mining and Extraction Module
ideas.summary: Optional field equipment that changes eligible extraction sites, yield, time, or risk while competing for Installation Space.

ideas.title: General Fabrication Module
ideas.summary: Field fabrication support that converts carried resources into bounded repair, ammunition, or mission support under explicit time and efficiency limits.

ideas.title: Expanded Cargo Bay
ideas.summary: Additional cargo capacity that consumes Installation Space and therefore competes directly with weapons, defenses, and other mission systems.

ideas.title: Magazine Expansion
ideas.summary: Space-consuming shared or family-specific ammunition storage that extends endurance without changing the Ready Package rule.

ideas.title: Communications Relay / Mission Communications Suite
ideas.summary: Improves contact, datalink, beacon, or strategic communication options while preserving signal observability and information provenance.

ideas.title: Boarding and Planetary Mission Package
ideas.summary: Swappable support package for boarding, rescue, landing, survey, or hazardous extraction, resolved as one mission package rather than individual loadouts.

ideas.title: Hardened Control and Cybersecurity Architecture
ideas.summary: Potential bounded defense against software/control compromise. Hostile intrusion requires explicit access, limits, counterplay, and may not grant arbitrary remote ship control.

ideas.title: Matter Transport / Portal System
ideas.summary: Preserved separately from ordinary FTL because transport of people, cargo, attacks, or boarding parties can bypass major gameplay systems; likely Exotic or tightly bounded if ever adopted.
